items.stem: A nurse must explain 'administer the medication orally twice daily' to a patient. Which rewording is most appropriate for the patient?

options.text: 'Take this medicine by mouth two times a day.'
options.rationale: Correct: plain language and correct meaning are appropriate for a patient.

options.text: 'Administer the pharmacological agent per os bis in die.'
options.rationale: Latin and jargon are inappropriate for a patient audience.
This is vague and does not convey the instruction.
This changes the meaning and is not an instruction.

items.explanation: Correct: plain language and correct meaning are appropriate for a patient.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: When scanning a clinical protocol to find a specific dose, what is the most efficient reading strategy?

options.text: Scan headings and numbers to locate the relevant section, then read closely
options.rationale: Correct: scanning for the target then reading closely is efficient and accurate.

options.text: Read every word from the start until you reach it
options.rationale: Reading everything is slow and unnecessary for locating a specific detail.

options.text: Guess the dose from memory without checking
options.rationale: Guessing a dose is unsafe and defeats the purpose of the protocol.
The title alone will not contain the specific dose.

items.explanation: Correct: scanning for the target then reading closely is efficient and accurate.

items.stem: Select TWO pieces of information a nursing referral/transfer letter should include.

options.text: The patient's current condition and relevant history
options.rationale: Correct: the receiving team needs the condition and pertinent history.

options.text: The reason for the referral or transfer
options.rationale: Correct: the purpose must be stated clearly.
Irrelevant to patient care and inappropriate.
Not clinical and not appropriate in a referral.

options.text: The brand of pen used to write the letter

items.explanation: Correct: the receiving team needs the condition and pertinent history. Correct: the purpose must be stated clearly.
